description: Use after buy_week_pass or buy_month_pass to check a pass key: returns status active, expired, revoked or invalid, with the plan and expiry for a genuine key. Grants no data. Free, no payment; the key is not logged.

key.description: The pass key returned by buy_week_pass or buy_month_pass; it starts with n402p_.

name: check_pass
title: Check a pass key
